patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a large product image balanced by a solid brand-color block containing the site title and introductory text.
Prominent use of oversized, elegant serif typography for main headings, often presented vertically to create strong visual anchors for content sections.
A consistent palette centered around a deep, rich brand green and a warm, light off-white background, creating a sophisticated and natural aesthetic.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
A horizontal product carousel (swiper) is used within a dedicated section to showcase multiple product variations.
Full-bleed imagery is frequently used for background sections, often with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text readability.

technique_notes: The primary navigation is fixed to the top of the browser window, maintaining its appearance and accessibility throughout the user's scroll.
Content sections are designed with full-bleed background images or solid brand-color fills, often incorporating a subtle dark gradient or overlay to enhance text contrast.
Headings utilize a bold, elegant serif typeface, scaled significantly larger than body text, with some key section titles oriented vertically to create a distinctive visual hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) with strong weight contrast, complemented by clean sans-serif body text and small uppercase labels. Section titles often use vertical orientation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on product containers; otherwise, mostly sharp edges for sections and imagery.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and key product sections, becoming more balanced in informational areas like news, maintaining a clean, uncluttered feel.

standout: The distinctive use of a rich, deep green as a primary brand color, combined with elegant, oversized serif typography for headings (including vertical text orientations), creates a sophisticated and memorable brand identity. The integration of high-quality product photography within full-bleed sections further elevates the visual experience.
